criteria.requirement: Add humanize.context.locale_scope(locale,path=None) / LocaleScope using ContextVar, the accepted source-aware real catalog loader and context-local translation plus decimal/thousands separators. Deterministically interleaved asyncio tasks must keep distinct same-locale catalogs; nested default-English scopes override thread state and restore outer state on exceptions/cancellation. Do not mutate global/other-task thread selections; legacy activate/deactivate remains thread-local and is hidden while an explicit scope is active. Reject active same-instance reentry, load failures leave context unchanged and permit sequential reuse after exit.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
